theme: 3 terms on motion: the closure that animates, the speed pattern, and the bouncy finish

terms.definition: A closure where you change a view's properties, so UIKit animates the change.
terms.example: Change the alpha inside the Animation Block, not before it.

terms.definition: The speed pattern of an animation, like starting slow and ending fast.
terms.example: Use ease out as the Animation Curve, it feels natural.

terms.definition: An animation that overshoots the end value and settles back, like a spring.
terms.example: The button uses a Spring Animation, so it bounces a little.

video.title: Animation Block, Animation Curve & Spring Animation | Day 103
video.description:
Learn to explain how UIKit animations are written and tuned: Animation Block, Animation Curve & Spring Animation, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Animation Block - A closure where you change a view's properties, so UIKit animates the change.
Animation Curve - The speed pattern of an animation, like starting slow and ending fast.
Spring Animation - An animation that overshoots the end value and settles back, like a spring.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 103 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS Animation Block, Animation Curve & Spring Animation | Day 103
landscape.description:
Explain Animation Block, Animation Curve & Spring Animation in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
애니메이션 블록, 애니메이션 커브, 스프링 애니메이션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Animation Block - A closure where you change a view's properties, so UIKit animates the change.
한국어: 애니메이션 블록: 뷰의 프로퍼티를 바꾸면 UIKit이 그 변화를 애니메이션으로 보여 주는 클로저

Animation Curve - The speed pattern of an animation, like starting slow and ending fast.
한국어: 애니메이션 커브: 느리게 시작해서 빠르게 끝나는 것처럼 애니메이션의 속도 패턴

Spring Animation - An animation that overshoots the end value and settles back, like a spring.
한국어: 스프링 애니메이션: 끝값을 살짝 넘었다가 스프링처럼 돌아와 멈추는 애니메이션

In this video, Mina and Jake make a popup appear with a smooth bounce, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: The popup jumps onto the screen. Can you explain how to animate it in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the popup jumps onto the screen. No animation at all.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you change `transform` inside an Animation Block?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, before it. Now it's inside, and it moves smoothly.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. What Animation Curve does it use?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The default one. It starts slow and ends slow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For a popup, I'd like a Spring Animation. It overshoots a little.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Like in the code? I set `usingSpringWithDamping` to 0.6.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. In a Spring Animation, lower damping means more bounce.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Too much bounce looks cheap, I think.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then try 0.8. Keep the Animation Block short, about half a second.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the spring replaces the Animation Curve?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mostly, yes. The spring decides the motion itself.
